title: Architecture record — written update
situation: In a technical discussion, a decision is based only on personal preference. You must write the decision accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Write four sentences recording the decision: the context, the options weighed, the choice, and its known consequence.

vocabulary.meaning: a short written trace of a choice and its context, so that a future reader can judge whether the reasoning still holds
an alternative that was considered and set aside, whose absence from a record is what makes the record unconvincing

expectedElements: The context that constrained the choice is stated
At least one rejected option is recorded
A known consequence of the choice is accepted
modelAnswer: A decision based on preference cannot be evaluated later, so it should be recorded in a form that can be. The record needs four elements: the context that constrained the choice, the options weighed, the option taken, and the consequence accepted. Rejected options are the part usually omitted and the part that makes a record convincing, because a reader can see why their preferred approach lost. When the context changes, the decision can then be reopened on evidence rather than on memory.
commonMistakes: Recording the choice without the alternatives that were set aside
Writing the record as a justification rather than as a reopenable decision
variants: Rewrite the update as the decision record itself, for one real choice.
